description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, along with CSS styles and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' within a StrictMode wrapper for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified DOM node.
